crew.overview: A set of six nested stories spanning time between the 19th century and a distant post-apocalyptic future. Cloud Atlas explores how the actions and consequences of individual lives impact one another throughout the past, the present and the future. Action, mystery and romance weave through the story as one soul is shaped from a killer into a hero and a single act of kindness ripples across centuries to inspire a revolution in the distant future.  Based on the award winning novel by David Mitchell. Directed by Tom Tykwer and the Wachowskis.
crew.title: Cloud Atlas

crew.overview: American car designer Carroll Shelby and the British-born driver Ken Miles work together to battle corporate interference, the laws of physics, and their own personal demons to build a revolutionary race car for Ford Motor Company and take on the dominating race cars of Enzo Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in France in 1966.
crew.title: Ford v Ferrari

crew.overview: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.
crew.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron

crew.original_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
crew.overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
crew.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

crew.original_title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
crew.overview: Following their explosive showdown, Godzilla and Kong must reunite against a colossal undiscovered threat hidden within our world, challenging their very existence – and our own.
crew.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire

crew.original_title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
crew.overview: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.
crew.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

crew.overview: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.
crew.title: Doctor Strange

crew.overview: Former cop Brian O'Conner partners with ex-con Dom Toretto on the opposite side of the law. Since Brian and Mia Toretto broke Dom out of custody, they've blown across many borders to elude authorities. Now backed into a corner in Rio de Janeiro, they must pull one last job in order to gain their freedom.
crew.title: Fast Five

crew.overview: After a disastrous first date for caterer Holly and network sports director Messer, all they have in common is a dislike for each other and their love for their goddaughter Sophie. But when they suddenly become all Sophie has in this world, Holly and Messer must set their differences aside. Juggling careers and social calendars, they'll have to find common ground while living under the same roof.
crew.title: Life As We Know It

details.biography:
Olivier Dumont is a visual effects supervisor. Early in his career, he spent over ten years working at BUF. His work spans a variety of ambitious and visually demanding projects. He supervised visual effects work for The Tree of Life (2011), Cloud Atlas (2012), Insurgent (2015), Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015), and Ford v Ferrari (2019), for which he served as the production visual effects supervisor.

Dumont’s work on Ford v Ferrari (2019) earned him nominations for several awards in visual effects, including the Satellite Awards, the Visual Effects Society Awards, and the AACTA Awards.
details.name: Olivier Dumont
